about_short_description.short_description: Pachyderm is an enterprise-grade data science platform that makes explainable, repeatable, and scalable AI/ML a reality.

product.name: Pachyderm Data Science Platform
product.description: A platform for deploying and managing multi-stage, language-agnostic data pipelines with data versioning and lineage tracking for reproducible AI/ML workflows.

product.name: Pachyderm Pipelines
product.description: A system to create and automate data-driven pipelines that run containerized code triggered by data changes, enabling scalable and reproducible data workflows.

product.name: Data Versioning System
product.description: A system that versions data repositories with Git-like semantics, tracking changes and lineage for reproducible data science workflows.

product.name: Data Ingestion Tools
product.description: Tools and methods to ingest data from various sources including local filesystems, cloud storage, streaming data, and SQL databases into Pachyderm repositories.

product.name: Integration with Toloka Crowdsourcing Platform
product.description: An integration that combines Pachyderm's data versioning and pipeline orchestration with Toloka's crowdsourced data labeling for scalable human-in-the-loop machine learning workflows.
